# Y3K Lab - y3klab.com

> The Y3K Lab hub. Each section below links to its plain-Markdown twin;
> the rendered version lives at the same path without the /<name>.md suffix.

- [Y3K Lab - Built for the year 3000](https://y3klab.com/): Y3K Lab - a retro-futurist synthwave incubator. Every experiment wears A3K, the Y3K design language, from a terminal to a race car.
- [A3K - Aesthetic 3000 · the Y3K design language](https://y3klab.com/a3k/a3k.md): A3K (Aesthetic 3000) is the Y3K design language - a retro-futurist synthwave look every Y3K experiment wears: neon magenta→cyan gradients, double-line box-drawing wordmarks, and brief power-on motion. The palette, the temperature map, the wordmarks, and the voice, in one place.
- [Blue Steel - a theme + status bar for Claude Code](https://y3klab.com/blue-steel/blue-steel.md): A really, really, ridiculously good-looking terminal. Blue Steel is a free theme + live status bar for Claude Code: neon gradient project name, context and rate-limit gauges, and a dark steel look.
- [Fractal Self-Describing Nodes [FSDN]](https://y3klab.com/fractal-self-describing-nodes/fractal-self-describing-nodes.md): Fractal Self-Describing Nodes (FSDN) - a structural law: every node describes itself, by the same rule, at every depth, so there is no index to keep. The structure is the index. Self-describing, one rule, every depth, no index. Every node is a fractal self.
- [Phos4 - the terminal-UI engine that renders A3K](https://y3klab.com/phos4/phos4.md): Phos4 is Y3K Lab's pure-bash, themeable terminal-UI engine - gradient-swept wordmarks, arrow-key pickers, panels, and spinners rendered from pure theme data, shipped as a single drop-in file. The engine that makes the terminal glow.
- [Project System - a tiny operating system for your projects](https://y3klab.com/project-system/project-system.md): A tiny operating system for your projects. Spin up, shelve, and archive a personal project portfolio from the terminal - no master list to keep, the workspace is the list. Pure bash, an arrow-key dashboard, Claude Code intake built in. Free from Y3K Lab.
